meta.name: Harlequins
meta.source: Harlequins (house army list, Horus Heresy 3rd edition)

units.name: Vaelith Duskmirror, the Laughing Lord

unitRules.name: Lord of the Masque
unitRules.text: Once per Player Turn, when the Controlling Player declares an Advanced Reaction from the Harlequin Army List for a Unit that has at least one Model within 12" of Vaelith (including Vaelith's own Unit), that Advanced Reaction costs no points from their Reaction Allotment. This does not allow a Unit to make more than one Reaction in the same Player Turn.

unitRules.name: The Endless Encore
unitRules.text: The first time in a battle that Vaelith would be Removed as a Casualty, roll a Dice. On a result of 4+, he is not Removed as a Casualty; instead he is removed from the Battlefield and placed in Reserves with 1 Wound remaining. He may enter play from Reserves as normal in a later turn, using the Deep Strike Special Rule even though he does not have it. If he was part of a Unit, the rest of that Unit remains on the Battlefield.

units.note: An original character written for this army list. The Great Harlequin who has led more masques than any living player can remember; he takes the Masque Trait of the army he leads.

unitRules.name: Choreographer
unitRules.text: If a Model with this Special Rule has joined a Unit, all Models in that Unit gain the Lightning Blows Special Rule.

unitRules.name: Master of the Performance
unitRules.text: Once per battle, at the start of any Phase, the Controlling Player of a Model with this Special Rule may gain one additional Reaction Point. If that point has not been spent by the end of that Phase, it is lost.

options.text: May have its Harlequin's Blade exchanged for an item from the Masque Leader Weapons List.
May have its Shuriken Pistol exchanged for an item from the Masque Leader Pistols List.
May have a Domino Field selected for it for +15 points.
May have one item from the Enigmas of the Black Library selected for it.

units.name: Sylandri Veilwalker

unitRules.name: Mistress of the Veiled Path
unitRules.text: Sylandri's Veil of Tears applies to Shooting Attacks whose closest attacking Model is more than 6" from the Target Unit (instead of 12"), and the Willpower Check it calls for is made with a -1 modifier.

unitRules.name: Path Through Shadows
unitRules.text: Once per battle, at the start of her Controlling Player's Movement Phase, Sylandri and any Unit she has joined may be removed from the Battlefield and set up again anywhere wholly within 18" of their previous position and more than 6" from any enemy Model. They count as having moved, and may not Rush or have a Charge declared for them in the same turn. They may not do so while Locked in Combat or Embarked.

options.text: Psychic Disciplines (up to two), in addition to the Phantasmancy of Veil of Tears.

units.note: Shadowseer of the Veiled Path. Her rules here are written for this army list.

unitRules.name: Choreographer
unitRules.text: If a Model with this Special Rule has joined a Unit, all Models in that Unit gain the Lightning Blows Special Rule.

May have its Shuriken Pistol exchanged for an item from the Masque Leader Pistols List.
May have a Domino Field selected for it for +15 points.
May have one item from the Enigmas of the Black Library selected for it.

May have one item from the Enigmas of the Black Library selected for it.
Psychic Disciplines (up to one), in addition to the Phantasmancy of Veil of Tears.

unitRules.name: Honour Guard of the Masque
unitRules.text: When an enemy Model issues a Challenge to a Unit that includes Models with this Special Rule and a Model with the Command Sub-Type that has joined it, the Controlling Player may have a Model with this Special Rule Accept the Challenge in place of that Model. A Model that does so gains a +1 modifier to its Focus Rolls for the duration of that Challenge.

options.text: Any Model in this Unit may have its Harlequin's Blade exchanged for an item from the Harlequin Melee Weapons List.
For every 3 Models in this Unit, one Model may have its Harlequin's Blade exchanged for a Harlequin's Caress for +10 points.
Any Model in this Unit may have its Shuriken Pistol exchanged for an item from the Harlequin Pistols List.

units.name: Solitaire

unitRules.name: The Lonely Path
unitRules.text: The Solitaire walks the Path of Damnation alone, and even other Harlequins keep their distance. A Model with this Special Rule may never join a Unit, and no Model may join its Unit. It is not affected by the Fear (X) Special Rule. It has no Masque Trait: it is not affected by any Masque's Special Rules, and it is ignored when checking that every Unit in a Detachment shares one Masque.

unitRules.name: Blitz
unitRules.text: Once per battle, at the start of its Controlling Player's Movement Phase, the Solitaire may Blitz instead of moving normally. Roll a number of Dice equal to the current battle turn number: the Solitaire may move up to that total in inches, passing over other Models and Terrain as though they were open ground, but may not end the move on top of another Model or in Impassable Terrain. Until the end of that turn, its Attacks Characteristic becomes 10.

unitRules.name: Impossible Form
unitRules.text: The Solitaire moves faster than the eye can follow. It has a 3+ Invulnerable Save, which is already included in its profile, and its Characteristics other than Wounds can never be reduced below their Base Values by enemy Rules or Special Rules.

unitRules.name: Twin Blades
unitRules.text: When the Solitaire makes Melee Attacks, its Controlling Player may split its Attacks between its Harlequin's Kiss and its Harlequin's Caress, declaring how many Attacks are made with each before any Hit Tests are made.

options.text: May have its Harlequin's Kiss exchanged for Cegorach's Rose for +20 points.
May have one item from the Enigmas of the Black Library selected for it.

units.note: A Solitaire has no Masque, so it never picks one and it can sit in any Masque's Detachment.

options.text: Any Model in this Unit may have its Harlequin's Blade exchanged for an item from the Harlequin Melee Weapons List.
For every 5 Models in this Unit, one Model may have its Harlequin's Blade exchanged for a Harlequin's Caress for +10 points.
For every 5 Models in this Unit, up to two Models may have their Shuriken Pistol exchanged for an item from the Harlequin Pistols List.
The Lead Player may have its Harlequin's Blade exchanged for an item from the Lead Player Weapons List.
The Lead Player may have its Shuriken Pistol exchanged for Crescendo for +15 points.
The Lead Player may have one item from the Enigmas of the Black Library selected for it.

units.name: Mimes

options.text: For every 5 Models in this Unit, one Model may have its Shuriken Pistol exchanged for a Neuro Disruptor for +5 points.

units.note: Silent infiltrators from the oldest Harlequin repertoire. They wear no holo-suit, and rely on never being seen.

unitRules.name: Death is Not Enough
unitRules.text: If a Shooting Attack made by a Model with this Special Rule causes one or more Models in the Target Unit to be Removed as Casualties, that Unit must make a Leadership Check with a -2 modifier in the Morale Sub-Phase of the same Player Turn. If the Check is failed, the Unit gains the Routed Tactical Status.

unitRules.name: Cruel Amusement
unitRules.text:
Each time a Model with this Special Rule makes a Shooting Attack, its Controlling Player chooses one of the following for its Shrieker Cannon until that Shooting Attack has been resolved:
• The Shrieker Cannon gains the Precision (5+) Special Rule.
• Cover Saves may not be taken against wounds inflicted by the Shrieker Cannon.
• The Firepower Characteristic of the Shrieker Cannon's Shrieker profile is modified by +1.

options.text: May have one item from the Enigmas of the Black Library selected for it.
Any Model in this Unit may have its Shuriken Cannon exchanged for a Haywire Cannon for +5 points per Model.
Any Model in this Unit may have its Star Bolas exchanged for a Zephyrglaive for free.

units.name: Harlequin Wraithlord

unitRules.name: Wraith-construct
unitRules.text: A wraithbone shell animated by the spirit of a dead Aeldari, painted in the colours of the masque it marches with. A Model with this Special Rule is not affected by the Fear (X) Special Rule and never gains the Pinned or Routed Tactical Status.

unitRules.name: Wraithsight
unitRules.text: The spirit within sees the battlefield only dimly without a psyker to guide it. At the start of its Controlling Player's turn, unless a Model with this Special Rule is within 12" of a friendly Model with the Psyker Trait (such as a Shadowseer), roll a Dice. On a result of 1, it gains the Stunned Tactical Status.

options.text: May have up to two of the following selected for it: Shuriken Cannon +10 points each, Haywire Cannon +10 points each, Prismatic Cannon +20 points each.
May have its Wraithbone Fists exchanged for a Wraithsword for +10 points.

units.note: The 1988 Rogue Trader Harlequin list included a dreadnought, the model that later became the Wraithlord; its rules here are written for this army list.

options.text: Any Voidweaver may have its Haywire Cannon exchanged for a Centreline mounted Prismatic Cannon for +10 points per model.

unitRules.name: Access Points
unitRules.text: The entire hull of the Starweaver is counted as an Access Point.

units.name: Webweaver

unitRules.name: Access Points
unitRules.text: The entire hull of the Webweaver is counted as an Access Point.

options.text: May have its Prismatic Cannon exchanged for a Turret mounted Haywire Cannon for free.

units.note: A larger cousin of the Starweaver, built to carry a whole troupe and its leaders through the webway. Written for this army list.

units.name: Prismweaver

options.text: May have both of its Shuriken Cannons exchanged for 2 Hull (front) mounted Haywire Cannons for +10 points.

units.note: A Harlequin battle-skimmer built around a twin prismatic cannon. Written for this army list.

units.name: Dreamweaver

unitRules.name: Access Points
unitRules.text: The entire hull of the Dreamweaver is counted as an Access Point.

unitRules.name: Theatre of the Laughing God
unitRules.text: A Unit that Disembarks from the Dreamweaver in the same turn that the Dreamweaver arrived on the Battlefield by Deep Strike may have a Charge declared for it in that turn.

units.note: The great stage-ship of a masque, carrying its players and their most terrible weapons into battle. Written for this army list.

unitRules.name: Unbridled Revel
unitRules.text: The Frozen Stars' bloodiest performers do not dodge: they hurl themselves at the foe and keep killing until the stage is clear. In the Fight Sub-Phase of an Assault Phase in which this Unit made a successful Charge, its Models modify their Attacks Characteristic by +1. However, this Unit may never have the Disengage aftermath option selected for it through The Great Dance unless it lost the Combat.

options.text: The Lead Reveller may have its Harlequin's Embrace exchanged for an item from the Lead Player Weapons List.
For every 5 Models in this Unit, up to two Models may have their Shuriken Pistol exchanged for an item from the Harlequin Pistols List.

units.note: Frozen Stars only. Written for this list: the masque of the most violent tales fields a troupe that has given up dodging.
units.name: Revel Troupe

unitRules.name: Dirge of the Fall
unitRules.text: The chorus of the Midnight Sorrow sings the fall of a race, and those who hear it lose heart. Enemy Units with at least one Model within 12" of this Unit modify the Leadership Characteristic of their Models by -1. In addition, an enemy Unit with the Routed Tactical Status that has any Models within 12" of this Unit may not remove that Status.

units.note: Midnight Sorrow only. Written for this list: the chorus that performs the Fall of the Aeldari.
units.name: Tragedians

unitRules.name: Figments
unitRules.text: Phantasms are illusions woven by the Veiled Path's Shadowseers, players who are not there. Models in this Unit may not make attacks of any kind, may not Control or Contest Objectives, may not be joined by other Models, and are not counted when an enemy scores Victory Points for destroying Units. At the start of its Controlling Player's turn, if this Unit has fewer Models than it began the battle with and has at least one Model within 24" of a friendly Model with the Psyker Trait, return one Model that was Removed as a Casualty to the Unit, placed in Unit Coherency and more than 1" from all enemy Models.

unitRules.name: Lure of the Veil
unitRules.text: When an enemy Unit declares a Shooting Attack or a Charge targeting a friendly Unit with the Veiled Path Trait (other than this Unit) that has any Models within 6" of this Unit, it must make an Intelligence Check. If the Check is failed, the Shooting Attack or Charge must target this Unit instead if this Unit is a legal target; otherwise it continues as declared. An enemy Unit makes at most one such Check in each Phase.

units.note: Veiled Path only. Written for this list: decoys projected by the masque of deception.
units.name: Phantasms

unitRules.name: Silence the Voice
unitRules.text: The Unspeaking kill those who give orders first, and a unit that loses its voice forgets what it was doing. If an attack made by a Model in this Unit destroys an enemy Model with the Command, Champion or Sergeant Sub-Type, that Model's Unit gains the Stunned Tactical Status.

units.note: Silent Shroud only. Written for this list: the elite mimes of the masque that never speaks.
units.name: The Unspeaking

unitRules.name: Laughing Pass
unitRules.text: The Soaring Spite fly low enough to be heard laughing. Once in each of its Controlling Player's Movement Phases, after this Model moves, its Controlling Player may select one enemy Unit that it moved over during that move. That Unit must make a Cool Check; if the Check is failed, it gains the Pinned Tactical Status.

units.note: Soaring Spite only. Written for this list: a webway fighter, the army's only Flyer.
units.name: Starshrike

unitRules.name: Already Dead
unitRules.text: Each of these players has died once on the stage of the Dreaming Shadow and returned to finish the tale. Models in this Unit have the Eternal Warrior (1) Special Rule, which is already included in their Special Rules, and are not affected by the Fear (X) Special Rule.

options.text: Any Model in this Unit may have its Harlequin's Blade exchanged for an item from the Harlequin Melee Weapons List.
For every 5 Models in this Unit, one Model may have its Harlequin's Blade exchanged for a Harlequin's Caress for +10 points.
For every 5 Models in this Unit, up to two Models may have their Shuriken Pistol exchanged for an item from the Harlequin Pistols List.
The Lead Player may have its Harlequin's Blade exchanged for an item from the Lead Player Weapons List.

units.note: Dreaming Shadow only. Written for this list: players of the masque haunted by the dead, who have died once already.
units.name: Deathmask Players

unitRules.name: Wraith-construct
unitRules.text: A wraithbone shell animated by the spirit of a dead Aeldari, painted in the colours of the masque it marches with. A Model with this Special Rule is not affected by the Fear (X) Special Rule and never gains the Pinned or Routed Tactical Status.

unitRules.name: Wraithsight
unitRules.text: The spirit within sees the battlefield only dimly without a psyker to guide it. At the start of its Controlling Player's turn, unless a Model with this Special Rule is within 12" of a friendly Model with the Psyker Trait (such as a Shadowseer), roll a Dice. On a result of 1, it gains the Stunned Tactical Status.

options.text: Any Model in this Unit may have its Ghostswords exchanged for a Ghostaxe for free.
Any Model in this Unit may have a Forceshield for +10 points per Model.

units.note: Wraithblades in Harlequin death masks: the spirits of dead players, still dancing. Written for this list; they follow on from the Rogue Trader dreadnought that became the Wraithlord.
units.name: Wraith-dancers

lists.name: Enigmas of the Black Library
lists.note: Each item may be selected only once per army. Cegorach's Rose, The Storied Sword and Crescendo are weapons, found in the Masque Leader lists, and are also once per army.

harbinger.name: Frozen Stars
harbinger.text:
The Masque of the Frozen Stars performs the most violent of the Laughing God's tales, and its players fight in a howling, hysterical frenzy that few audiences survive.

All Models with the Frozen Stars Trait are subject to the following Special Rules:

Hysterical Fury
Models with the Frozen Stars Trait that do not have the Vehicle Type gain the Impact (S) Special Rule. However, a Unit that only includes Models with the Frozen Stars Trait that is within 12" of any enemy Unit at the start of its Controlling Player's Charge Sub-Phase must declare a Charge if it is able to do so.

Frozen Stars Gambit
Hysterical Onslaught
When selecting a Gambit, the Controlling Player of a Model with the Frozen Stars Trait can select Hysterical Onslaught instead of any others available to that Model. If this Gambit is selected, the Model's Attacks Characteristic is modified by +2 for the duration of the following Strike Step. However, for each unmodified Hit Test result of 1 rolled for this Model's attacks in that Strike Step, the Model suffers a wound with an AP of 4 and a Damage of 1, allocated at the end of the Strike Step.

gambits.name: Hysterical Onslaught
gambits.text: When selecting a Gambit, the Controlling Player of a Model with the Frozen Stars Trait can select Hysterical Onslaught instead of any others available to that Model. If this Gambit is selected, the Model's Attacks Characteristic is modified by +2 for the duration of the following Strike Step. However, for each unmodified Hit Test result of 1 rolled for this Model's attacks in that Strike Step, the Model suffers a wound with an AP of 4 and a Damage of 1, allocated at the end of the Strike Step.

harbinger.name: Midnight Sorrow
harbinger.text:
The Midnight Sorrow perform the Fall of the Aeldari, and carry its grief onto every battlefield. They do not flee from a fate they have already danced a thousand times.

All Models with the Midnight Sorrow Trait are subject to the following Special Rules:

Sorrow Unbowed
Whenever a Unit that only includes Models with the Midnight Sorrow Trait would gain the Routed Tactical Status, it gains the Pinned Tactical Status instead. However, such a Unit may never have the Disengage or Fall Back aftermath options selected for it through The Great Dance Special Rule, and is not required to select them when it loses a Combat.

Midnight Sorrow Prime Advantage
If a Unit that only includes Models with the Midnight Sorrow Trait is selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot, the following Prime Advantage can be selected:

Herald of the Fall
All Models in the Unit gain the Fear (1) Special Rule. When the last Model in the Unit is Removed as a Casualty, every enemy Unit with at least one Model within 12" of that Model must make a Leadership Check. Any Unit that fails this Check gains the Routed Tactical Status.

harbinger.name: Veiled Path
harbinger.text:
Masters of deception and misdirection, the players of the Veiled Path are never quite where the foe's guns are aimed.

All Models with the Veiled Path Trait are subject to the following Special Rules:

Cegorach's Veil
Models with the Veiled Path Trait and a Holo-suit have the Shrouded (5+) Special Rule or, if they already have a variant of the Shrouded (X) Special Rule, improve its value by 1, to a maximum of Shrouded (4+). However, a Unit that includes any Models with the Veiled Path Trait that made a Shooting Attack in its Controlling Player's last Shooting Phase loses this benefit until the start of its Controlling Player's next turn.

Veiled Path Gambit
Hall of Mirrors
When selecting a Gambit, the Controlling Player of a Model with the Veiled Path Trait can select Hall of Mirrors instead of any others available to that Model. If this Gambit is selected, then in the following Strike Step, Hit Tests made for the opposing Model are only successful on a result of 5+, and Hit Tests made for this Model are only successful on a result of 4+, regardless of the Weapon Skill Characteristics of the Models involved.

gambits.name: Hall of Mirrors
gambits.text: When selecting a Gambit, the Controlling Player of a Model with the Veiled Path Trait can select Hall of Mirrors instead of any others available to that Model. If this Gambit is selected, then in the following Strike Step, Hit Tests made for the opposing Model are only successful on a result of 5+, and Hit Tests made for this Model are only successful on a result of 4+, regardless of the Weapon Skill Characteristics of the Models involved.

harbinger.name: Silent Shroud
harbinger.text:
The Silent Shroud never speak, on stage or off. Their wordless performances leave audiences mute with dread long after the players have gone.

All Models with the Silent Shroud Trait are subject to the following Special Rules:

Mute Dread
Models with the Silent Shroud Trait gain the Fear (1) Special Rule. If such a Model already has a variant of the Fear (X) Special Rule, increase its value of X by 1 instead, to a maximum of Fear (2). However, Models without the Silent Shroud Trait may never join a Unit that includes Models with the Silent Shroud Trait, and Models with the Silent Shroud Trait may never join a Unit that includes Models without it.

Silent Shroud Advanced Reaction
The Controlling Player of any Units that only include Models with the Silent Shroud Trait can spend Reaction Points to make the following Advanced Reaction:

The Silent Scream
Trigger: The Reactive Player may declare The Silent Scream Advanced Reaction at the end of Step 3 of the Charge process of any Charge declared by the Active Player that targets a Unit which only includes Models with the Silent Shroud Trait.

Cost: The Reactive Player must spend 1 point of their Reaction Allotment to declare The Silent Scream Advanced Reaction, this cost paid as soon as the declaration is made.

Target: The Target Unit is always the Unit whose Charge triggered the Reaction. The Reacting Unit is always the Unit that was declared as the target of the Charge that triggered this Reaction.

Process:
1. Once this Reaction is declared, the Active Player must make a Leadership Check for the Target Unit, applying the negative modifier of the Reacting Unit's highest variant of the Fear (X) Special Rule even if it would not otherwise apply.
2. If the Check is failed, the Charge fails, no Charge Move is made, and the Target Unit gains the Pinned Tactical Status. If the Check is passed, the Charge proceeds as normal.

reactions.name: The Silent Scream
reactions.text:
Trigger: The Reactive Player may declare The Silent Scream Advanced Reaction at the end of Step 3 of the Charge process of any Charge declared by the Active Player that targets a Unit which only includes Models with the Silent Shroud Trait.

Cost: The Reactive Player must spend 1 point of their Reaction Allotment to declare The Silent Scream Advanced Reaction, this cost paid as soon as the declaration is made.

Target: The Target Unit is always the Unit whose Charge triggered the Reaction. The Reacting Unit is always the Unit that was declared as the target of the Charge that triggered this Reaction.

Process:
1. Once this Reaction is declared, the Active Player must make a Leadership Check for the Target Unit, applying the negative modifier of the Reacting Unit's highest variant of the Fear (X) Special Rule even if it would not otherwise apply.
2. If the Check is failed, the Charge fails, no Charge Move is made, and the Target Unit gains the Pinned Tactical Status. If the Check is passed, the Charge proceeds as normal.

harbinger.name: Soaring Spite
harbinger.text:
The Soaring Spite are famed for the speed of their Skyweavers and grav-skimmers, and for the contempt they show any foe who cannot keep pace.

All Models with the Soaring Spite Trait are subject to the following Special Rules:

Lords of the Upper Air
Models with the Soaring Spite Trait and the Jink Trait modify their Movement Characteristic by +2. However, a Unit that includes any Models with the Soaring Spite Trait that Rushed in its Controlling Player's last Movement Phase may not Control or Contest Objectives until the start of its Controlling Player's next turn.

Soaring Spite Advanced Reaction
The Controlling Player of any Units that only include Models with the Soaring Spite and Jink Traits can spend Reaction Points to make the following Advanced Reaction:

Spite of the Skies
Trigger: The Reactive Player may declare a Spite of the Skies Advanced Reaction in Step 2 of the Move Sub-Phase process, if an enemy Unit ends a move within 12" and Line of Sight of a Unit under the Reactive Player's control that only includes Models with the Soaring Spite and Jink Traits.

Cost: The Reactive Player must spend 1 point of their Reaction Allotment to declare a Spite of the Skies Advanced Reaction, this cost paid as soon as the declaration is made.

Target: The Target Unit is always the Unit whose move triggered the Reaction. Once the cost has been paid, the Reactive Player must select one Unit under their control that only includes Models with the Soaring Spite and Jink Traits, is within 12" and has Line of Sight to the Target Unit. That Unit is the Reacting Unit.

Process:
1. Once the Target Unit has finished its move, the Reacting Unit makes a Shooting Attack targeting the Target Unit. All attacks made as part of this Shooting Attack are made as Snap Shots.
2. Once the Shooting Attack has been resolved, each Model in the Reacting Unit may be moved up to 6", but may not end this move within 1" of any enemy Model.

reactions.name: Spite of the Skies
reactions.text:
Trigger: The Reactive Player may declare a Spite of the Skies Advanced Reaction in Step 2 of the Move Sub-Phase process, if an enemy Unit ends a move within 12" and Line of Sight of a Unit under the Reactive Player's control that only includes Models with the Soaring Spite and Jink Traits.

Cost: The Reactive Player must spend 1 point of their Reaction Allotment to declare a Spite of the Skies Advanced Reaction, this cost paid as soon as the declaration is made.

Target: The Target Unit is always the Unit whose move triggered the Reaction. Once the cost has been paid, the Reactive Player must select one Unit under their control that only includes Models with the Soaring Spite and Jink Traits, is within 12" and has Line of Sight to the Target Unit. That Unit is the Reacting Unit.

Process:
1. Once the Target Unit has finished its move, the Reacting Unit makes a Shooting Attack targeting the Target Unit. All attacks made as part of this Shooting Attack are made as Snap Shots.
2. Once the Shooting Attack has been resolved, each Model in the Reacting Unit may be moved up to 6", but may not end this move within 1" of any enemy Model.

harbinger.name: Dreaming Shadow
harbinger.text:
The Dreaming Shadow are haunted by the souls of the Aeldari dead, and perform their tales as though already among them. They fight on long after other players would have fallen.

All Models with the Dreaming Shadow Trait are subject to the following Special Rules:

Embrace the End
Models with the Dreaming Shadow Trait that do not have the Vehicle Type gain the Feel No Pain (6+) Special Rule. While a Unit that only includes Models with the Dreaming Shadow Trait has fewer than half of its starting number of Models, its Models modify their Attacks Characteristic by +1. However, Models with the Dreaming Shadow Trait modify their Cool Characteristic by -1.

Dreaming Shadow Prime Advantage
If a Unit that only includes Models with the Dreaming Shadow Trait and the Infantry or Cavalry Type is selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot, the following Prime Advantage can be selected:

Death's Promise
All Models in the Unit gain the Eternal Warrior (1) Special Rule. If a Model already has a variant of the Eternal Warrior (X) Special Rule, increase its value of X by 1 instead, to a maximum of Eternal Warrior (2).

wargear.name: Holo-suit
wargear.text:
A holo-suit breaks its wearer's outline into a storm of shifting colour, so that blows and shots meet a cloud of fragments instead of a body, and the faster the wearer moves the wilder the storm. A Model with a Holo-suit has a 4+ Invulnerable Save. This is already included in the Invulnerable Save Characteristic of every Model that has a Holo-suit as standard wargear.

In addition, if the Model Rushed in its Controlling Player's last Movement Phase, it has the Shrouded (5+) Special Rule until the start of that Player's next turn or, if it already has a variant of the Shrouded (X) Special Rule, it improves that value by 1 instead, to a maximum of Shrouded (4+).

wargear.name: Flip Belt
wargear.text: A small anti-grav generator keyed to its wearer's thoughts, letting them leap, tumble and somersault across the battlefield. A Model with a Flip Belt has the Move Through Cover Special Rule. In addition, when a Unit that only includes Models with Flip Belts Moves, Rushes, makes a Charge Move or makes a Disengage move, its Models may move over other Models and Terrain as though they had the Antigrav Sub-Type, but must end the move at least 1" away from any Model that is not part of the same Unit.

wargear.name: Plasma Grenades
wargear.text:
When making Volley Attacks during Step 4 of the Charge Procedure with a Unit that includes at least one Model with Plasma Grenades, the Controlling Player may choose to make a single attack with a Plasma Grenade instead of making a normal Shooting Attack using the following profile:
R 6, FP 1, RS 4, AP 4, D 1, Special Rules: Blast (3"), Traits: Assault.

wargear.name: Domino Field
wargear.text: A more sophisticated holo-field that shatters its wearer into a cascade of fragments, making them very hard to hit. A Model with a Domino Field has the Shrouded (5+) Special Rule.

wargear.name: Holo-field
wargear.text: A Harlequin vehicle's holo-field smears its silhouette into a blur of light. A Model with a Holo-field has a 5+ Invulnerable Save. If the Model moved more than half of its Movement Characteristic in its Controlling Player's last Movement Phase, it has a 4+ Invulnerable Save instead.

wargear.name: Mirage Launchers
wargear.text: Once per battle, at the start of any Shooting Phase, the Controlling Player of a Model with Mirage Launchers may fire them. Until the end of that Phase, the Model and any Unit Embarked upon it gain the Shrouded (4+) Special Rule or, if they already have a variant of the Shrouded (X) Special Rule, improve its value by 1, to a maximum of Shrouded (3+).

wargear.name: The Laughing God's Eye
wargear.text: Enigma of the Black Library. A gem through which the bearer glimpses the threads of fate, and guards those around it from the warp. All friendly Units with at least one Model within 12" of the Model with The Laughing God's Eye modify their Willpower Characteristic by +1.

wargear.name: The Mask of Secrets
wargear.text: Enigma of the Black Library. A mask that shows each foe the face of their own death. The Model with The Mask of Secrets gains the Fear (2) Special Rule, and automatically passes any Leadership or Cool Check it is called upon to make.

wargear.name: Starmist Raiment
wargear.text: Enigma of the Black Library. A holo-suit woven from the light of a dying star, which blazes brightest as its wearer runs. If the Model with Starmist Raiment Rushed in its Controlling Player's last Movement Phase, it has a 3+ Invulnerable Save until the start of that Player's next turn.

wargear.name: Forceshield
wargear.text: A wraithbone shield that projects a field of force. A Model with a Forceshield has a 4+ Invulnerable Save.

specialRules.name: The Great Dance
specialRules.text:
The Harlequins fight as they perform: a blur of colour that is never quite where the blow lands, darting in to kill and flipping away before the foe can answer.

Rising Crescendo: From the second battle turn onwards, a Unit that only includes Models with this Special Rule and the Infantry or Paragon Type may have a Charge declared for it in a turn in which it Rushed. It may not make Volley Attacks as part of that Charge.

Exit, Pursued: A Unit that only includes Models with this Special Rule may always have the Disengage aftermath option selected for it in Step 4 of the Resolution Sub-Phase of the Assault Phase, regardless of which Player won the Combat. When such a Unit makes a Disengage move, its Models may move through enemy Models, but must end that move more than 1" away from all enemy Models.

However, a Unit that only includes Models with this Special Rule that has lost a Combat must have either the Disengage or the Fall Back aftermath option selected for it if it is able to. The Harlequins do not stand and grind against a foe that has taken their measure.

specialRules.name: Dodge (X)
specialRules.text:
"Dodge (X) is a Damage Mitigation Test that may be taken in addition to a Saving Throw."

A Model with the Dodge (X) Special Rule gains a Dodge Damage Mitigation Test that may be used to discard Wounds allocated to the Model that were inflicted by Attacks made in either of the following situations:
• The Attack was made during the Assault Phase,
• The Attack was made as part of a Reaction.

A Damage Mitigation Test may be made after and in addition to a Saving Throw, including an Invulnerable Save. The Target Number for a Dodge Damage Mitigation Test is the value of X attached to the specific variant of the Special Rule.

specialRules.name: Veil of Tears
specialRules.text:
The Shadowseer weaves the Laughing God's illusions around the players, so that the foe fires upon phantoms and empty air.

When an enemy Unit declares a Shooting Attack targeting a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule, and the closest Model in the attacking Unit is more than 12" from the Target Unit, the Controlling Player of the attacking Unit must make a Willpower Check for it. If the Check is failed, all attacks made as part of that Shooting Attack must be made as Snap Shots. Units that include any Models with the Psyker Trait, and attacks made with a Weapon that has any variant of the Precision (X) Special Rule, ignore this Special Rule.

specialRules.name: Firing Deck (X)
specialRules.text: In the Shooting Phase, a Unit that is Embarked on a Transport Model that has this Special Rule can be selected to make a Shooting Attack, even though it is not on the Battlefield. A number of Embarked Models up to the value noted in the specific variant of the Firing Deck (X) Special Rule may attack as part of that Shooting Attack, and the Shooting Attack must target an Enemy Unit which is in one of the Facings of the Transport noted in the specific variant of the Firing Deck (X) Special Rule. Models making Attacks as part of that Shooting Attack count as having moved if the Transport moved in the preceding Movement Phase and as Stationary if it did not, but must make Attacks as Snap Shots if the Transport moved a number of inches higher than half its Movement Characteristic in the preceding Movement Phase. Ranges are measured from the Hull of the Transport. Reactions made against the Attack that would Target the Unit Target the Transport it is Embarked on instead.

specialRules.name: Additional Reaction Point
specialRules.text: If an Army's Primary Detachment is from the Harlequin Army List, the Controlling Player gains one additional Reaction Point if that Detachment contains any Models with the Masque Leader Trait.

reactions.name: The Silent Scream
reactions.text:
Silent Shroud Advanced Reaction.

Trigger: The Reactive Player may declare The Silent Scream Advanced Reaction at the end of Step 3 of the Charge process of any Charge declared by the Active Player that targets a Unit which only includes Models with the Silent Shroud Trait.

Cost: The Reactive Player must spend 1 point of their Reaction Allotment to declare The Silent Scream Advanced Reaction, this cost paid as soon as the declaration is made.

Target: The Target Unit is always the Unit whose Charge triggered the Reaction. The Reacting Unit is always the Unit that was declared as the target of the Charge that triggered this Reaction.

Process:
1. Once this Reaction is declared, the Active Player must make a Leadership Check for the Target Unit, applying the negative modifier of the Reacting Unit's highest variant of the Fear (X) Special Rule even if it would not otherwise apply.
2. If the Check is failed, the Charge fails, no Charge Move is made, and the Target Unit gains the Pinned Tactical Status. If the Check is passed, the Charge proceeds as normal.

reactions.name: Spite of the Skies
reactions.text:
Soaring Spite Advanced Reaction.

Trigger: The Reactive Player may declare a Spite of the Skies Advanced Reaction in Step 2 of the Move Sub-Phase process, if an enemy Unit ends a move within 12" and Line of Sight of a Unit under the Reactive Player's control that only includes Models with the Soaring Spite and Jink Traits.

Cost: The Reactive Player must spend 1 point of their Reaction Allotment to declare a Spite of the Skies Advanced Reaction, this cost paid as soon as the declaration is made.

Target: The Target Unit is always the Unit whose move triggered the Reaction. Once the cost has been paid, the Reactive Player must select one Unit under their control that only includes Models with the Soaring Spite and Jink Traits, is within 12" and has Line of Sight to the Target Unit. That Unit is the Reacting Unit.

Process:
1. Once the Target Unit has finished its move, the Reacting Unit makes a Shooting Attack targeting the Target Unit. All attacks made as part of this Shooting Attack are made as Snap Shots.
2. Once the Shooting Attack has been resolved, each Model in the Reacting Unit may be moved up to 6", but may not end this move within 1" of any enemy Model.

reactions.name: Shadow Dance
reactions.text:
The players dissolve into fragments of light as the guns open up, and are somewhere else entirely by the time the smoke clears.

Trigger: The Reactive Player may declare a Shadow Dance Advanced Reaction at the start of Step 3 of the Shooting Attack sequence of a Shooting Attack made by the Active Player that targets a Unit which only includes Models with the Harlequin Trait and either a Holo-suit or a Holo-field.

Cost: The Reactive Player must spend 1 point of their Reaction Allotment to declare a Shadow Dance Advanced Reaction, this cost paid as soon as the declaration is made.

Target: The Target Unit is always the Unit whose Shooting Attack triggered the Reaction. The Reacting Unit is always the Unit that was the target of the Shooting Attack that triggered the Reaction.

Process:
1. All Models in the Reacting Unit gain the Shrouded (5+) Special Rule against attacks made as part of this Shooting Attack. Models in the Reacting Unit that already have a variant of the Shrouded (X) Special Rule instead improve its value by 1 (Shrouded (5+) becomes Shrouded (4+), and so on), to a maximum of Shrouded (3+).
2. Once the Shooting Attack has been resolved, if the Reacting Unit is not Locked in Combat, each Model in the Reacting Unit may be moved a number of inches up to its Initiative Characteristic (or up to 6" for a Model with the Vehicle Type). Each Model must end this move further from the Target Unit than it began it, in Unit Coherency, and more than 1" away from any enemy Model.

reactions.name: The Laughing God's Riposte
reactions.text:
The charge meets nothing but a ripple of laughter, and then the blades are already falling.

Trigger: The Reactive Player may declare The Laughing God's Riposte Advanced Reaction at the end of Step 3 of the Charge process of any Charge declared by the Active Player that targets a Unit which only includes Models with the Harlequin Trait and either the Infantry or the Cavalry Type.

Cost: The Reactive Player must spend 1 point of their Reaction Allotment to declare The Laughing God's Riposte Advanced Reaction, this cost paid as soon as the declaration is made.

Target: The Target Unit is always the Unit whose Charge triggered the Reaction. The Reacting Unit is always the Unit that was declared as the target of the Charge that triggered this Reaction.

Process:
1. Once this Reaction is declared, the Reacting Unit may not make Volley Attacks as part of this Charge.
2. If the Charge is successful, then until the end of the Assault Phase no Model in the Target Unit may claim a bonus from any Special Rule that requires a successful Charge to have been made (such as Impact (X) or Lightning Blows), and all Models in the Reacting Unit gain a +1 modifier to their Combat Initiative.

gambits.name: Hysterical Onslaught
gambits.text: Frozen Stars Gambit. When selecting a Gambit, the Controlling Player of a Model with the Frozen Stars Trait can select Hysterical Onslaught instead of any others available to that Model. If this Gambit is selected, the Model's Attacks Characteristic is modified by +2 for the duration of the following Strike Step. However, for each unmodified Hit Test result of 1 rolled for this Model's attacks in that Strike Step, the Model suffers a wound with an AP of 4 and a Damage of 1, allocated at the end of the Strike Step.

gambits.name: Hall of Mirrors
gambits.text: Veiled Path Gambit. When selecting a Gambit, the Controlling Player of a Model with the Veiled Path Trait can select Hall of Mirrors instead of any others available to that Model. If this Gambit is selected, then in the following Strike Step, Hit Tests made for the opposing Model are only successful on a result of 5+, and Hit Tests made for this Model are only successful on a result of 4+, regardless of the Weapon Skill Characteristics of the Models involved.

gambits.name: Cegorach's Jest
gambits.text:
When selecting a Gambit, the Controlling Player of a Model with the Harlequin Trait can select Cegorach's Jest instead of any others available to that Model. This Gambit can only be selected after the Opposing Player has selected a Gambit for their Model in the same Focus Step.

If this Gambit is selected, the Controlling Player gains a +1 modifier to the Focus Roll. If the Controlling Player then wins the Focus Roll, the Gambit selected for the opposing Model has no effect for the remainder of that round of the Challenge.

primeAdvantages.name: Webway Strike
primeAdvantages.text:
If a Unit with the Harlequin Trait is selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot in a Detachment, the Webway Strike Prime Advantage may be selected:

The Unit for which this Prime Advantage was selected, and any Model with the Transport Sub-Type it begins the battle Embarked upon, gains the Deep Strike Special Rule. A Deep Strike made by that Unit, or by the Transport carrying it, does not count towards the limit of one Unit attempting a Deep Strike in a given Player Turn.

traits.name: Xenos
traits.text: The 'Xenos' trait replaces the Allegiance Trait for Xenos factions. An army that includes models with the Xenos Trait may still include models with either the Loyalist or Traitor Trait, but not the other.

traits.name: Harlequin
traits.text: The 'Harlequin' Trait indicates Units that can be selected as part of a Harlequin army.

traits.name: [Masque]
traits.text: Every Harlequin belongs to a Masque, a travelling company of players with its own repertoire and its own way of war. If a Unit has the [Masque] Trait listed instead of a specific Masque, one of the following Traits must be selected for it during Army creation: Frozen Stars, Midnight Sorrow, Veiled Path, Silent Shroud, Soaring Spite, Dreaming Shadow. Every Unit in an Auxiliary or Apex Detachment must have the same Masque Trait; Units without a Masque Trait (such as a Solitaire) are ignored for this restriction. The Primary Detachment may include Units from several Masques.

traits.name: Masque Leader
traits.text: The Great Harlequins choreograph the whole performance, and the Masque answers their cues with uncanny speed. The Masque Leader Trait has no effect on its own, but is referred to by other Rules and Special Rules.

traits.name: Jink
traits.text: Aeldari jetbikes and grav-skimmers are exceptionally fast and agile, and can weave through firestorms that would leave any other pilots flat-footed. The Jink Trait has no effect on its own, but is referred to by other Rules and Special Rules.

traits.name: Psyker
traits.text: A Model with this Trait is a psyker. Rules that affect psykers affect it, and it may suffer Perils of the Warp when a Rule or Special Rule, such as Force (X), instructs it to.

detachments.name: Frenzied Revel
detachments.unlock: When a model with the Frozen Stars Trait is selected to fill a Command Slot, then the Player may add a Frenzied Revel to the Army instead of the options available in the Crusade Force Organization Chart.
restrictions: Only Units with the Frozen Stars Trait may be selected to fill Slots in this Detachment.
detachments.note: A Frozen Stars troupe let off the leash.

detachments.name: Chorus of Lament
detachments.unlock: When a model with the Midnight Sorrow Trait is selected to fill a Command Slot, then the Player may add a Chorus of Lament to the Army instead of the options available in the Crusade Force Organization Chart.
restrictions: Only Units with the Midnight Sorrow Trait may be selected to fill Slots in this Detachment.
detachments.note: The Death Jesters of the Midnight Sorrow and the troupe they mourn for.

detachments.name: Hall of Illusions
detachments.unlock: When a model with the Veiled Path Trait is selected to fill a Command Slot, then the Player may add a Hall of Illusions to the Army instead of the options available in the Crusade Force Organization Chart.
restrictions: Only Units with the Veiled Path Trait may be selected to fill Slots in this Detachment.
detachments.note: Mimes and players of the Veiled Path, never where they seem to be.

detachments.name: Silent Procession
detachments.unlock: When a model with the Silent Shroud Trait is selected to fill a Command Slot, then the Player may add a Silent Procession to the Army instead of the options available in the Crusade Force Organization Chart.
restrictions: Only Units with the Silent Shroud Trait may be selected to fill Slots in this Detachment.
detachments.note: A wordless column of Mimes and players.

detachments.name: Skyborne Host
detachments.unlock: When a model with the Soaring Spite Trait is selected to fill a Command Slot, then the Player may add a Skyborne Host to the Army instead of the options available in the Crusade Force Organization Chart.
restrictions: Only Units with the Soaring Spite Trait may be selected to fill Slots in this Detachment.
detachments.note: Skyweavers and Voidweavers of the Soaring Spite.

detachments.name: Masque of the Dead
detachments.unlock: When a model with the Dreaming Shadow Trait is selected to fill a Command Slot, then the Player may add a Masque of the Dead to the Army instead of the options available in the Crusade Force Organization Chart.
restrictions: Only Units with the Dreaming Shadow Trait may be selected to fill Slots in this Detachment.
detachments.note: The Dreaming Shadow perform for the dead, and bring their whole company, the wraith-constructs included.

detachments.name: The Lonely Path
restrictions: Only a Solitaire may be selected to fill the Slot in this Detachment.

detachments.name: The Great Masque
restrictions: Only Units with the Harlequin Trait may be selected to fill Slots in this Detachment.

detachments.name: Weaver Constellation
restrictions: Only Prismweavers and Voidweavers may be selected to fill Slots in this Detachment.

The following Prime Advantage must be selected for the Model selected to fill the Prime Slot in this Detachment: Prismatic Master: The Model for which this Prime Advantage was selected has its Base Ballistic Skill Characteristic changed to 6, and its Prismatic Cannons (including a Twin Prismatic Cannon) gain the Pinning (1) Special Rule in every mode.

detachments.name: Warlord Detachment
restrictions: Must be the same faction as the Primary Detachment.
May only be selected in a 3,000 point or larger army.

detachments.name: Lord of War Detachment
restrictions: The total points value of this Detachment may not exceed 25% of the army total.

forceorg.note: Horus Heresy 3rd edition Crusade Force Organisation Chart and core detachments, from the Warhammer Community army-building summary.

unlocks.text: For every Command slot filled in the Crusade Primary Detachment the army may include one Auxiliary Detachment. Filling its High Command slot allows one Apex Detachment.

detachments.name: Warlord Detachment
restrictions: Must be the same faction as the Primary Detachment.
May only be selected in a 3,000 point or larger army.

detachments.name: Lord of War Detachment
restrictions: The total points value of this Detachment may not exceed 25% of the army total.

primeAdvantages.name: Master Sergeant
primeAdvantages.text: One model in the unit gains +1 Attacks, +1 Weapon Skill and +1 Leadership, and the Champion sub-type.

primeAdvantages.name: Combat Veterans
primeAdvantages.text: Models in the unit gain +1 Leadership, Intelligence, Cool and Willpower.

primeAdvantages.name: Paragon of Battle
primeAdvantages.text: The model gains +1 Attacks, +1 Weapon Skill and +1 Ballistic Skill.

primeAdvantages.name: Special Assignment
primeAdvantages.text: A Prime Command slot becomes a High Command slot.

primeAdvantages.name: Logistical Benefit
primeAdvantages.text: Add one slot to the Detachment, of any Battlefield Role other than High Command, Command, Warlord or Lord of War.

coreRules.note: Rules referenced by the Necron list but defined in the Horus Heresy 3rd edition rulebook, not the codex. The app labels them so players know where to look.

grantedPrimeAdvantages.name: Herald of the Fall
grantedPrimeAdvantages.text: If a Unit that only includes Models with the Midnight Sorrow Trait is selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot, the following Prime Advantage can be selected: Herald of the Fall. All Models in the Unit gain the Fear (1) Special Rule. When the last Model in the Unit is Removed as a Casualty, every enemy Unit with at least one Model within 12" of that Model must make a Leadership Check. Any Unit that fails this Check gains the Routed Tactical Status.

grantedPrimeAdvantages.name: Death's Promise
grantedPrimeAdvantages.text: If a Unit that only includes Models with the Dreaming Shadow Trait and the Infantry or Cavalry Type is selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot, the following Prime Advantage can be selected: Death's Promise. All Models in the Unit gain the Eternal Warrior (1) Special Rule. If a Model already has a variant of the Eternal Warrior (X) Special Rule, increase its value of X by 1 instead, to a maximum of Eternal Warrior (2).

grantedPrimeAdvantages.name: Prismatic Master
grantedPrimeAdvantages.text: The Model for which this Prime Advantage was selected has its Base Ballistic Skill Characteristic changed to 6, and its Prismatic Cannons (including a Twin Prismatic Cannon) gain the Pinning (1) Special Rule in every mode.
grantedPrimeAdvantages.note: Must be selected for the Prime Slot of the Weaver Constellation Apex Detachment.

Models with the Veiled Path Trait and a Holo-suit have the Shrouded (5+) Special Rule or, if they already have a variant of the Shrouded (X) Special Rule, improve its value by 1, to a maximum of Shrouded (4+).
